description: List Airflow 3.x asset materialization events (newest first by default). Each event names the source DAG/task/run plus any downstream DAG runs the materialization triggered. Filterable by assetId, sourceDagId, sourceRunId, sourceTaskId, and a timestamp window — pair with dbt-mcp lineage to trace cross-tool data flow.

orderBy.description: Order-by field; default '-timestamp' is most useful for 'what changed recently?'

sourceDagId.description: Filter to events produced by this DAG

sourceRunId.description: Filter to events produced by this DAG run

sourceTaskId.description: Filter to events produced by this task id

timestampGte.description: ISO-8601 lower bound on event timestamp (inclusive).

timestampLte.description: ISO-8601 upper bound on event timestamp (inclusive).

name: airflow-list-asset-events
